description: Tracks whose file size is exactly 10,323,804 bytes are included along with larger ones.

c.request: Considering only tracks that pass a file-size (`Track.Bytes`) cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. What is the simple average of these per-media-type averages? Return just that single value, unrounded. Tracks whose file size is exactly 10,323,804 bytes are included along with larger ones.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(media_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_avg FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name) AS per_media_type;

a.request: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is at least 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. What is the simple average of these per-media-type averages? Return just that single value, unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(media_type_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) AS per_media_type;

d.request: For each media type, average `Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds` across tracks with `Track.Bytes >= 10323804`, then return the unrounded simple average of those per-media-type averages as a single value.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(media_avg) FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS media_avg FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) AS per_media_type

b.request: For each media type, calculate the average `Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds` across tracks with `Track.Bytes >= 10323804`, then return the unrounded arithmetic mean of those per-media-type averages as a single value.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(media_type_avg) FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) AS per_media_type;
b.raw: For each media type, calculate the average `Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds` across tracks with `Track.Bytes >= 10323804`, then return the unrounded arithmetic mean of those per-media-type averages as a single value.
